01 — Inspector

Video Editor & Creative Post-Production.

I'm Umar — a video editor with over two years of hands-on experience across film editing, brand advertisement editing, fashion video editing, sound design, and motion graphics. I work exclusively in Adobe Premiere Pro, handling colour grading, motion graphics, text animation, effects, transitions, and sound design end-to-end on every project.

I build a strong first assembly instinctively, without overthinking structure — shaped less by formula than by close attention to current trends and visual style. I haven't taken on a paid brand engagement yet; the work here comes from self-initiated practice projects, also featured on my Behance.

03 — How I Colour Grade

How I colour grade.

Every project starts from the source format — a full grade built from scratch on LOG footage, colour correction and refinement on Rec.709. The pairs below are unedited before/after exports: same frame, same timestamp, graded entirely in Adobe Premiere Pro.

04 — Timeline

How a project actually runs.

Same sequence every time, so nothing gets lost between raw footage and final export.

00:00

Review & cull

Every clip goes on the timeline and gets assessed — shaky, poorly lit, or unusable footage never makes the cut.

00:12

Find the track

I read the emotion and rhythm of the footage first, then find music that actually connects with it.

00:25

Sync & sound design

Footage cut to the music's pace, with vocal effects and SFX layered in to elevate the audio.

00:38

Colour grade

LOG footage graded from scratch; Rec.709 footage colour corrected and refined.

00:50

Effects & impact

Overlays and effects added after the grade, timed to the SFX for a real sense of presence.

01:05

Render & deliver

Every frame rendered, the file exported, and the final cut sent to the client.

05 — Deliver

Ready to render this?

Send over your footage, brand assets, or even just a rough idea. I'll come back with a timeline and a quote before anything gets cut.
